# Saltmarsh

The weekly orders of a community kitchen: members sign in, pick the week's dishes and change their
order until it closes. The requirements live in the context repository, `saltmarsh-context`.

- `saltmarsh/members.py` — a member, and the one-time code they sign in with
- `saltmarsh/orders.py` — the week's order of one member
- `saltmarsh/menu.py` — the week's dishes
